senses.en: people you know who can help you, especially professionally

example.en: He has many useful business contacts.
example.zh: 他有许多有用的业务联系人。

senses.en: communications or interactions between people or organizations; plural of contact

example.en: Diplomatic contacts between the two countries resumed.
example.zh: 两国之间恢复了外交接触。

senses.en: a person from Russia

example.en: Many Russians celebrate the New Year with family.
example.zh: 许多俄罗斯人和家人一起庆祝新年。

senses.en: the official language of Russia

example.en: She is learning Russian at university.
example.zh: 她在大学里学习俄语。

senses.en: relating to Russia, its people, or its language

example.en: He enjoys Russian literature.
example.zh: 他喜欢俄罗斯文学。

senses.en: an earthquake; a shaking of the ground

example.en: The quake damaged several buildings in the city.
example.zh: 这次地震损坏了市里的几座建筑。

senses.en: to shake or tremble, especially from fear

example.en: He quaked with fear during the storm.
example.zh: 暴风雨中他吓得发抖。

senses.en: the rising of Jesus Christ from the dead, celebrated by Christians

example.en: Christians celebrate the resurrection of Jesus at Easter.
example.zh: 基督徒在复活节庆祝耶稣的复活。

senses.en: a revival of something that had been inactive or forgotten

example.en: The band's comeback was seen as a resurrection of classic rock.
example.zh: 乐队的回归被视为经典摇滚的复兴。

senses.en: the ability to understand an event after it has happened

example.en: In hindsight, the decision was a mistake.
example.zh: 事后看来，那个决定是个错误。

senses.en: a shocking event or action that causes public outrage

example.en: The corruption scandal forced the minister to resign.
example.zh: 腐败丑闻迫使部长辞职。

senses.en: malicious gossip about people's private lives
senses.zh: 流言蜚语；揭人隐私的闲话

example.en: She was hurt by the scandal spread about her private life.
example.zh: 关于她私生活的流言蜚语让她深受伤害。

senses.en: usually; in most cases

example.en: This plant is commonly found in gardens.
example.zh: 这种植物常见于花园里。

senses.en: rising or falling sharply; sloping a lot

example.en: The path up the mountain is very steep.
example.zh: 上山的路非常陡峭。

senses.en: of a price or increase, too high; excessive

example.en: The price of the tickets seems a bit steep.
example.zh: 票价似乎有点太贵了。

senses.en: to leave food, tea, etc. in liquid to soak up flavor

example.en: Let the tea steep for five minutes.
example.zh: 让茶泡五分钟。

senses.en: existing as a fact and not imagined

example.en: The threat to the village was real.
example.zh: 对村庄的威胁是真实存在的。

senses.en: genuine and not fake

example.en: She wore a real gold necklace.
example.zh: 她戴着一条真金项链。

senses.en: the basic unit of money in Brazil

example.en: He paid ten reais for the coffee.
example.zh: 他为这杯咖啡付了十个雷亚尔。

senses.en: the name of a book, film, song, or other work
senses.zh: 书名、电影名、歌曲名等作品的名称

example.en: The title of the novel appears on the cover.
example.zh: 小说的书名出现在封面上。

senses.en: a heading or name given to a section, document, or legal bill
senses.zh: 章节、文件或法案的标题；名称

example.en: The bill's title summarizes its main purpose.
example.zh: 该法案的标题概括了其主要目的。

senses.en: to give a name or title to a book, film, or other work
senses.zh: 给（书、电影等作品）命名；加标题

example.en: She titled her first novel after a local river.
example.zh: 她以当地一条河流的名字为她第一部小说命名。

senses.en: to tell someone about possible danger, harm, or risk
senses.zh: 警告；提醒有危险或风险

example.en: The lifeguard warned swimmers about the strong current.
example.zh: 救生员警告游泳者注意强劲的水流。

senses.en: to advise someone to do or not do something

example.en: The doctor warned him not to lift heavy objects.
example.zh: 医生告诫他不要提重物。

senses.en: to change something completely, especially in a way that improves it

example.en: The new bridge transformed the small town.
example.zh: 这座新桥使这个小镇彻底改观。

senses.en: to change something into a different form or state

example.en: The device transforms sunlight into electricity.
example.zh: 这个装置把阳光转化为电能。

senses.en: to take air into the lungs and let it out

example.en: People breathe faster during exercise.
example.zh: 人在运动时呼吸会加快。

senses.en: to let air pass through

example.en: Cotton clothing lets the skin breathe.
example.zh: 棉质衣物让皮肤透气。

senses.en: a small container holding ink, toner, or film for a device such as a printer or camera

example.en: We need to buy a new ink cartridge for the printer.
example.zh: 我们需要给打印机买一个新墨盒。

senses.en: a cylindrical case of ammunition containing the bullet and explosive charge

example.en: The soldier loaded a cartridge into the rifle.
example.zh: 士兵往步枪里装了一发子弹。

senses.en: the quality of tasting like sugar

example.en: The sweetness of the mango surprised me.
example.zh: 这芒果的甜味让我吃惊。

senses.en: a kind, pleasant, or gentle quality

example.en: I will always remember her sweetness and kindness.
example.zh: 我会永远记得她的温柔和善良。

senses.en: earlier than a time or event

example.en: Please let me know beforehand if you can't come.
example.zh: 如果你不能来，请提前告诉我。

senses.en: toward the south

example.en: The birds fly southwards in autumn.
example.zh: 秋天鸟儿向南飞。

senses.en: the official religious leaders of a religion, such as priests or ministers

example.en: The clergy gathered at the cathedral for the special service.
example.zh: 神职人员们聚集在大教堂参加这次特别的礼拜。

senses.en: the process or business of producing printed text or images

example.en: The printing of the new book took two weeks.
example.zh: 这本新书的印刷花了两周时间。

senses.en: a single production run of a book

example.en: The first printing sold out quickly.
example.zh: 第一次印刷很快就售罄了。

senses.en: writing letters by hand separately, like printed type

example.en: Please fill out the form in block printing.
example.zh: 请用正体字填写表格。

senses.en: a sheltered area of water where ships can safely anchor

example.en: The fishing boats returned to the harbour before the storm.
example.zh: 渔船在暴风雨来临前返回了港口。

senses.en: a place offering safety or refuge

example.en: The small cabin was a harbour from the noise of city life.
example.zh: 小木屋是远离城市喧嚣的一处港湾。

senses.en: to secretly shelter or give protection to someone

example.en: He was accused of harbouring a fugitive.
example.zh: 他被指控窝藏一名逃犯。

senses.en: to keep a feeling or thought in one's mind, often for a long time

example.en: She still harbours hopes of becoming a professional singer.
example.zh: 她仍然怀有成为职业歌手的希望。

senses.en: an electronic machine that stores and processes data

example.en: She uses her computer to write reports and send emails.
example.zh: 她用电脑写报告和发电子邮件。

senses.en: the fourth month of the year, after March and before May

example.en: The cherry blossoms usually bloom in April.
example.zh: 樱花通常在四月开放。

senses.en: a device for receiving radio broadcasts
senses.zh: 收音机；无线电接收设备

example.en: She turned on the radio to listen to the news.
example.zh: 她打开收音机听新闻。

senses.en: the broadcasting of programs by radio waves; the medium itself

example.en: I heard the song on the radio this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上在广播里听到了这首歌。

senses.en: to send a message by radio

example.en: The pilot radioed the control tower for help.
example.zh: 飞行员用无线电向控制塔求助。

senses.en: grown or produced without artificial chemicals
senses.zh: 以有机方式；不施化肥农药地

example.en: The vegetables are organically grown.
example.zh: 这些蔬菜是有机种植的。

senses.en: in a natural, gradual, or spontaneous way

example.en: The project grew organically over the years.
example.zh: 这个项目多年来自然发展起来。

senses.en: a small crude shelter or hut

example.en: They lived in a wooden shanty by the river.
example.zh: 他们住在河边的一间木棚屋里。

senses.en: a rhythmical work song sung by sailors
senses.zh: 水手号子；船夫劳动号子

example.en: The sailors sang a shanty while pulling the ropes.
example.zh: 水手们拉绳时唱着劳动号子。

senses.en: a large rodent covered with sharp spines that can rise up when it is in danger

example.en: A porcupine raised its quills when the dog came close.
example.zh: 狗靠近时，豪猪竖起了身上的刺。

senses.en: the hole in a lock where the key is inserted

example.en: He peered through the keyhole to see who was inside.
example.zh: 他从锁眼里偷看里面是谁。

senses.en: a large horse-drawn carriage formerly used to carry passengers and mail between towns

example.en: The stagecoach took three days to cross the mountains.
example.zh: 这辆驿马车花了三天时间翻越群山。

senses.en: relevant and appropriate to the matter being discussed

example.en: Please keep your comments germane to the topic.
example.zh: 请让您的评论紧扣主题。

senses.en: the holiest city of Islam, in western Saudi Arabia

example.en: Mecca is the birthplace of Muhammad.
example.zh: 麦加是穆罕默德的出生地。

senses.en: a place that attracts many visitors

example.en: The town has become a mecca for surfers.
example.zh: 这座小镇成了冲浪者的热门去处。

senses.en: lack of action or activity, especially when action is needed

example.en: The government was criticized for its inaction on the crisis.
example.zh: 政府因在危机中无所作为而受到批评。

senses.en: to notice something with your eyes

example.en: I can see the mountains from my window.
example.zh: 我从窗户能看见那些山。

senses.en: to understand or realize something

example.en: I see what you mean now.
example.zh: 我现在明白你的意思了。

senses.en: to meet or visit someone

example.en: I'm going to see my grandmother this weekend.
example.zh: 这个周末我要去看望我的祖母。

senses.en: to find out or check something

example.en: See if the door is locked.
example.zh: 看看门锁了没有。

senses.en: the land along the edge of a sea, lake, or other large body of water

example.en: We walked along the shore at sunset.
example.zh: 日落时我们沿着岸边散步。

senses.en: to support or strengthen something with a prop or beam

example.en: Workers shore up the tunnel walls with steel beams.
example.zh: 工人用钢梁支撑隧道墙壁。

senses.en: meat from cattle

example.en: We had roast beef for dinner.
example.zh: 我们晚餐吃了烤牛肉。

senses.en: a complaint or grievance

example.en: She has a beef about the new schedule.
example.zh: 她对新日程安排有不满。

senses.en: to complain

example.en: He kept beefing about the noise.
example.zh: 他不停地抱怨噪音。

senses.en: a public announcement that promotes a product, service, or event

example.en: I saw an advertisement for a new phone on TV.
example.zh: 我在电视上看到一款新手机的广告。

senses.en: an opening that lets air, gas or smoke escape

example.en: Open the vent to let the steam out.
example.zh: 打开通风口让蒸汽排出去。

senses.en: to express strong feelings freely

example.en: She vented her anger on the phone call.
example.zh: 她在电话里发泄了怒气。

senses.en: to allow air or gas to escape from a space

example.en: The pipe vents gases outside the building.
example.zh: 管道把气体排放到建筑物外。

senses.en: the quality of being bright; the amount of light something gives or reflects

example.en: Turn down the brightness on your screen at night.
example.zh: 晚上把屏幕亮度调低。

senses.en: cheerful and lively quality

example.en: Her smile added brightness to the room.
example.zh: 她的微笑给房间增添了明快的气息。

senses.en: a hard, white, translucent ceramic material used for making dishes, vases, and other objects

example.en: The museum displays fine porcelain from the Ming dynasty.
example.zh: 博物馆展出了精美的明代瓷器。

senses.en: an object made of this material

example.en: She carefully wrapped each piece of porcelain before packing.
example.zh: 她小心地把每件瓷器包好再装箱。

senses.en: in a firm or close manner; with a strong grip

example.en: She held the rope tightly so it would not slip.
example.zh: 她紧紧抓住绳子，以免它滑落。

senses.en: securely fixed or fastened

example.en: Make sure the lid is tightly sealed before shaking the jar.
example.zh: 摇晃罐子前，确保盖子已经拧紧封好。

senses.en: relating to a king or queen

example.en: The royal family lives in a large palace.
example.zh: 王室成员住在一座大宫殿里。

senses.en: grand or impressive in size or style

example.en: They gave us a royal welcome at the airport.
example.zh: 他们在机场给了我们盛大的欢迎。

senses.en: a member of a royal family (informal)

example.en: Crowds gathered to see the royals arrive.
example.zh: 人群聚集起来观看王室成员抵达。

senses.en: an earlier action or decision that serves as an example or rule for later similar cases

example.en: The court's ruling set an important precedent for future cases.
example.zh: 法院的裁决为以后的案件树立了一个重要的先例。

senses.en: coming before in time, order, or importance

example.en: The precedent chapter explains the basic theory.
example.zh: 前一章解释了基本理论。

senses.en: to change and improve something, especially a piece of writing or a plan

example.en: She revised her essay after the teacher's comments.
example.zh: 根据老师的意见，她修改了自己的文章。

senses.en: to study again before an exam (British English)

example.en: He is revising for his final exams this week.
example.zh: 他这周正在为期末考试复习。

senses.en: to change one's opinion or estimate based on new information

example.en: The company revised its sales forecast downward.
example.zh: 公司下调了销售预测。

senses.en: a common medicine used to relieve pain, reduce fever, and thin the blood

example.en: He took an aspirin for his headache.
example.zh: 他吃了一片阿司匹林来缓解头痛。

senses.en: relating to plants or the study of plants

example.en: The garden contains a rare botanical collection from South America.
example.zh: 这座花园收藏着来自南美洲的珍稀植物。

senses.en: a medicine or product made from a plant

example.en: Many cosmetics now contain natural botanicals.
example.zh: 许多化妆品现在都含有天然植物成分。

senses.en: the way a person acts toward others

example.en: His behaviour at the meeting surprised everyone.
example.zh: 他在会议上的举止让所有人感到惊讶。

senses.en: the way a machine, substance, or system acts under certain conditions
senses.zh: （机器、物质等的）表现；运行特性

example.en: Scientists studied the behaviour of the metal at high temperatures.
example.zh: 科学家们研究了这种金属在高温下的表现。

senses.en: a person who pretends to be someone else in order to deceive

example.en: The impostor pretended to be a doctor for years.
example.zh: 这个冒名顶替者多年来一直假扮医生。

senses.en: a motorcycle

example.en: He rides his motorbike to work every day.
example.zh: 他每天骑摩托车上班。

senses.en: the belief that pleasure is the most important thing in life

example.en: His life of luxury and travel was pure hedonism.
example.zh: 他奢侈与漫游的生活纯粹是享乐主义。

senses.en: requiring a lot of effort and energy; very difficult

example.en: They began the arduous climb to the mountain top.
example.zh: 他们开始了登顶的艰巨攀爬。

senses.en: the act of avoiding something such as a question, duty, or payment

example.en: His answers were clever evasions rather than real explanations.
example.zh: 他的回答只是巧妙的推托，而非真正的解释。

senses.en: to arrange laws or rules into a systematic code

example.en: The government moved to codify the country's laws.
example.zh: 政府着手将该国法律编纂成典。

senses.en: a small place or group that reflects a larger society or system

example.en: The village is a microcosm of the whole country.
example.zh: 这个村庄是整个国家的缩影。

senses.en: to cut small pieces from wood with a knife

example.en: He sat by the fire whittling a piece of wood.
example.zh: 他坐在火旁削一块木头。

senses.en: to gradually reduce something

example.en: The new rules whittled down the staff's benefits.
example.zh: 新规定逐渐削减了员工的福利。
